name: Eligibility 1 Code
definition: Identifies the type of investor. The rules that apply to each type of client are different.

ELIG.name: Eligible Counterparty
ELIG.definition: Eligible customers are the most sophisticated level of investor, able to opt out of some the protections afforded by conduct of business rules.

RETL.name: Retail Client
RETL.definition: Retail customers are the least sophisticated level of investor.

PROF.name: Professional Client
PROF.definition: Professional customers are, for example, investment firms, credit institutions, insurance companies.
